'''Donegan Varr''' was an [[Emissary/Legends|emissary]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] participated in Republic combat drills under the guidance of Varr.<ref name="TOR Encyclopedia" />
